1: Kaaf Ha Ya Ain Saad. Aise huroof ke baare mein baat Surah Al-Baqarah mein ho chuki hai.
2: Yeh aap ke Rubb ki us rehmat ka zikr hai jo Us ne apne bande Zakariya (alaihis salaam) par ki, jise Main aap ko sunata hoon taake aap us se sabaq lein.
3: Jab unhon ne apne Rubb ko chupke se pukara, taake us ka qabool hona zyada mumkin ho.
4: Unhon ne kaha: 'Aey mere Rubb, meri haddiyan kamzor pad gayi hain, mere sar ke safed baal barh gaye hain, aur main tujh se dua karne mein kabhi na-kaam nahin hua. Balke jab bhi maine tujh se dua ki, tu ne qabool ki.
5: Aur mujhe dar hai ke mere rishtedaar mere baad deen ke haqooq poore nahin karenge, duniya ki zindagi mein doob jaane ki wajah se. Aur meri biwi baanjh hai, lihaza mujhe apni taraf se aisi aulaad ata farma jo meri madad kare.
6: Woh mujh se nabuwwat ka waris ho aur Yaqub (alaihis salaam) ke gharane ka waris bhi. Aur aey Rubb, use apne deen, apne akhlaaq aur apne ilm mein pasandeeda bana.'
7: Chunanche Allah ne un ki dua qabool ki aur unhein pukara: 'Aey Zakariya (alaihis salaam), Main tumhein woh khabar de raha hoon jo tumhein khush kar degi. Maine tumhari dua qabool kar li aur tumhein ek beta ata kiya jis ka naam Yahya (alaihis salaam) hoga. Maine yeh naam us se pehle kisi ko nahin diya.'
8: Zakariya (alaihis salaam) ne Allah ki qudrat par hairan ho kar kaha: 'Mere haan bachcha kaise hoga jab ke meri biwi baanjh hai aur main boorhape aur haddiyon ki kamzori ki aakhiri hadd ko pahunch chuka hoon?'
9: Farishte ne kaha: 'Baat waisi hi hai jaisi aap ne kahi, yani yeh ke aap ki biwi baanjh hai aur aap boorhape aur haddiyon ki kamzori ki aakhiri hadd ko pahunch chuke hain. Magar aap ke Rubb ne farmaya: aap ke Rubb ke liye Yahya (alaihis salaam) ko ek baanjh maa se aur ek aise baap se paida karna jo bahut boorha ho chuka hai, aasan hai. Aur aey Zakariya (alaihis salaam), Maine aap ko is se pehle paida kiya jab aap zikr karne ke laayak koi cheez bhi nahin the, kyunke aap tha hi nahin.'
10: Zakariya (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: 'Aey mere Rubb, mujhe koi aisi nishani de jis se mujhe itminan ho aur jo batae ke woh khush-khabri jo farishton ne mujhe di woh poori ho gayi.' Us ne farmaya: 'Tumhari us khush-khabri ke poora hone ki nishani yeh hai ke tum teen din logon se baat nahin kar sakoge, kisi beemari ki wajah se nahin, balke tum tandurust aur bhale-change hoge.'
11: Phir Zakariya (alaihis salaam) apni ibadat-gah se nikal kar apni qaum ke paas aaye, aur bina bole unhein ishara kiya ke din ke shuru aur din ke aakhir mein Allah ki paaki bayan karein.
12: Phir un ke haan Yahya (alaihis salaam) paida hue. Jab woh us umar ko pahunche jis mein unhein khitaab kiya ja sake, to Maine un se kaha: 'Aey Yahya, Taurat ko mazbooti aur mehnat ke saath thaam lo.' Aur Maine unhein samajh, ilm, sabit-qadmi aur pakka irada diya, jab ke woh abhi bachche the.
13: Aur Maine unhein apni taraf se rehmat di aur unhein gunahon se paak rakha. Aur woh parhezgaar the, Allah ke ahkaam par chalte the aur Us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bachte the.
14: Aur woh apne maa-baap ke saath achha sulook karne wale the, un ke saath narm aur un par meharban. Aur woh na apne Rubb ki itaat ya apne maa-baap ki itaat se gurur karte the, aur na apne Rubb ya apne maa-baap ke nafarmani karne wale the.
15: Aur un par Allah ki taraf se salaamati aur aman hai us din jab woh paida hue, us din jab woh wafat paa kar is zindagi se jayenge, aur us din jab woh Qayamat ke din zinda uthaye jayenge. Yeh teen jaghein wohi hain jo insaan ke liye sab se zyada haulnaak hoti hain, lihaza agar woh in mein mehfooz raha to use kisi aur jagah koi khauf nahin hoga.
16: Aur aey Rasool, apne par utari hui kitab mein Maryam (alaihas salaam) ka qissa bayan kijiye, jab woh apne ghar walon se alag ho kar un ke mashriq ki taraf ek jagah tanha rehne lagin.
17: Chunanche unhon ne apne liye logon se ek parda bana liya jo unhein dhaap de, taake jab woh apne Rubb ki ibadat kar rahi hon to log unhein na dekh sakein. Phir Maine un ki taraf Jibreel (alaihis salaam) ko bheja, to woh un ke saamne ek poore insaan ki shakl mein zaahir hue. Is par unhon ne samjha ke us ka irada un ke saath bura hai.
18: Chunanche jab unhon ne use ek poore insaan ki shakl mein apni taraf aate dekha, to unhon ne kaha: 'Main tujh se Rehman ki panaah maangti hoon ke tujh se mujhe koi nuqsan pahunche, agar tu parhezgaar hai aur Allah se darta hai.'
19: Jibreel (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: 'Main insaan nahin hoon. Main to sirf aap ke Rubb ka bheja hua hoon jise Us ne aap ki taraf bheja hai taake main aap ko ek achha aur paak beta ata karoon.'
20: Maryam (alaihas salaam) ne hairan ho kar kaha: 'Mere haan bachcha kaise ho sakta hai jab ke na koi shauhar aur na koi aur mere qareeb aaya, aur na main zina karne wali hoon ke mere haan bachcha ho?'
21: Jibreel (alaihis salaam) ne un se kaha: 'Baat waisi hi hai jaisi aap ne kahi, yani yeh ke na kisi shauhar ne aur na kisi aur ne aap ko chhua, aur na aap zina karne wali hain. Magar aap ke Rubb ne farmaya: baap ke baghair bachcha paida karna Mere liye aasan hai. Aur yeh is liye hai ke jo bachcha aap ko ata kiya ja raha hai woh logon ke liye Allah ki qudrat ki nishani ho, aur un par Meri taraf se rehmat ho, us bhalai ki wajah se jo unhein us ke zariye milegi. Aur aap ke is bachche ka paida hona Allah ka ek muqarrar faisla hai jo Lauh-e-Mehfooz mein likha hua hai.'
22: Chunanche farishte ke phoonk maarne ke baad unhein hamal thehar gaya, phir woh use le kar logon se door ek jagah chali gayin.
23: Aur zacha ki takleef ne unhein pakad liya aur unhein khajoor ke ek darakht ke tane ka sahara lene par majboor kar diya. Maryam (alaihas salaam) ne kaha: 'Kaash main is din se pehle mar jati aur aisi cheez hoti jis ka zikr tak na hota, taake mere baare mein bura gumaan na kiya jata.'
24: Phir Jibreel (alaihis salaam) ne unhein waadi ke neeche se pukara: 'Gam na kijiye. Aap ke Rubb ne aap ke neeche paani ka ek chashma bana diya hai jis se aap pi sakti hain.
25: Aur darakht ka tana pakad kar use hilaiye; woh foran aap par taaze pake hue khajoor giraa dega.
26: Lihaza in pake hue khajooron mein se khaiye, paani piyiye, aur apne bachche par khush rahiye aur gam na kijiye. Aur agar aap kisi aise shaks ko dekhein jo aap se bachche ke baare mein pooche, to us se keh dijiye: maine apne Rubb ke liye khamoshi ka ahd kar liya hai, is liye main aaj kisi insaan se baat nahin karoongi.'
27: Phir Maryam (alaihas salaam) apne bachche ko uthaye apni qaum ke paas aayin. Un ki qaum ne hairan ho kar un se kaha: 'Aey Maryam, tum ne ek bahut sangeen ghadi hui baat kar daali, ke bina baap ke ek bachcha le aayin.
28: Aey woh jo ibadat mein Haroon (alaihis salaam) jaise ek neik shaks se milti hai, tumhara baap zina karne wala nahin tha aur na tumhari maa aisi thi. Tum ek paak gharane se ho jo neki ke liye jaana jata hai, phir tum bina baap ke bachcha kaise le aayin?'
29: Unhon ne apne bete Isa (alaihis salaam) ki taraf ishara kiya jo gohd mein the. Is par logon ne hairan ho kar kaha: 'Hum us bachche se kaise baat karein jo gohd mein hai?'
30: Isa (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: 'Main Allah ka banda hoon. Us ne mujhe Injeel di aur mujhe apne nabiyon mein se banaya.
31: Aur Us ne mujhe bandon ke liye bahut bara faida banaya, main jahan bhi hoon. Aur Us ne mujhe hukm diya ke jab tak main zinda rahoon namaz padhoon aur zakaat doon.
32: Aur Us ne mujhe apni maa ke saath achha sulook karne wala banaya. Aur Us ne mujhe na apne Rubb ki itaat se gurur karne wala banaya aur na un ka nafarmani karne wala.
33: Aur shaytanon aur un ke madadgaron se salaamati mujh par hai us din jab main paida hua, us din jab main maroonga, aur us din jab main Qayamat ke din uthaya jaoonga. In teen haulnaak jaghon mein shaytan ka mujh par koi bura asar nahin hai.'
34: Jin ki yeh sifaat hain woh Isa (alaihis salaam) ibn-e-Maryam (alaihas salaam) hain. Aur un ke baare mein yeh baat haqq ki baat hai, woh nahin jo gumraah log kehte hain jo un ke maamle mein shak aur ikhtilaaf karte hain.
35: Allah ke liye yeh zaib nahin deta ke Us ka koi beta ho, paak aur buland hai Woh is se. Jab Woh kisi cheez ka irada karta hai to Us ke liye is cheez ke baare mein itna kehna kaafi hai: 'ho ja', aur woh zaroor ho jati hai. Lihaza jo aisa hai woh aulaad se paak hai.
36: Aur Allah, paak hai Woh, mera bhi Rubb hai aur tumhara bhi Rubb, lihaza ibadat sirf Usi ke liye khaalis karo. Yeh jo maine tumhein bataya, yahi seedha raasta hai jo Allah ki razamandi tak pahunchata hai.
37: Magar Yahood aur Nasara ke giroh Isa (alaihis salaam) ke maamle mein ikhtilaaf kar baithe. Yahood ne un ke baare mein kaha ke woh jaadugar hain. Aur kuch Nasara ne un ke baare mein kaha ke woh Allah ke bete hain. Lihaza un logon ke liye barbaadi hai jo un ke baare mein ikhtilaaf karte hain, Qayamat ke bade din ko dekhne se, us ke manzaron, us ke hisaab aur us ke azaab ki wajah se.
38: Qayamat ke din woh jo sunenge aur dekhenge woh kitna haulnaak hoga, aur un ke liye kitna sakht hoga. Aur un ka woh haal jo aap dekhenge kitna ajeeb hoga. Magar duniya ki is zindagi mein zaalim khul kar seedhe raaste se bhatke hue hain. Woh Aakhirat ki koi tayyari nahin karenge yahan tak ke woh achanak un par aa jayegi jab ke woh apne zulm mein pade honge.
39: Aur aey Rasool, logon ko hasrat ke din se daraaiye, jab burai karne wala apni buraiyon par pachhtayega aur neik shaks is par pachhtayega ke us ne aur zyada itaat kyun na ki, jab bandon ke aamaal-naame lapet diye jayenge, un ka hisaab poora ho jayega aur har shaks us ki taraf jayega jo us ne aage bheja. Magar woh apni duniya ki zindagi ke dhoke mein hain aur Aakhirat se gaafil hain, aur woh Qayamat ke din ko nahin maante.
40: Main hi hoon jo makhlooq ke mit jaane ke baad baaqi rahunga. Main zameen ka aur jo us par hain un ka waris banunga, kyunke woh mit chuke honge aur Main un ke baad baaqi rahunga, aur Main un ka maalik hoon aur un ke saath jo chahta hoon karta hoon. Aur Qayamat ke din unhein sirf Meri hi taraf lautna hai taake un ka hisaab ho aur unhein badla mile.
41: Aur aey Rasool, us Quran mein, jo aap par utara gaya, Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ka qissa bayan kijiye. Woh bade sachche the aur Allah ki nishaniyon par pakka iman rakhte the.
42: Jab unhon ne apne baap Aazar se kaha: 'Aey baap, aap Allah ke siwa us but ki ibadat kyun karte hain jo aap ki dua na sun sake agar aap use pukarein, aap ki ibadat na dekh sake jab aap us ki ibadat karein, aap se koi nuqsan na hata sake aur aap ko koi faida na pahuncha sake?
43: Aey baap, mere paas wahi ke zariye aisa ilm aaya hai jo aap ke paas nahin aaya, lihaza mere peeche chaliye, main aap ko seedhe raaste ki hidayat doonga.
44: Aey baap, shaytan ki itaat karke us ki ibadat na kijiye. Shaytan Rehman ka nafarmani karne wala hai, kyunke Us ne use Adam (alaihis salaam) ko sajda karne ka hukm diya magar us ne sajda na kiya.
45: Aey baap, mujhe dar hai ke aap par Rehman ki taraf se koi azaab aa pade agar aap apne kufr par mar gaye, phir aap us ki dosti ki wajah se azaab mein us ke saathi honge.'
46: Aazar ne apne bete Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) se kaha: 'Aey Ibrahim, kya tum mere poojne wale buton se munh mod rahe ho? Agar tum mere buton par tanqeed karna band na karoge to main tumhein paththar maaroonga. Mujhe ek lambi muddat ke liye chhod do. Mujh se baat na karo aur mere saath na raho.'
47: Ibrahim (alaihis salaam) ne apne baap se kaha: 'Aap par meri taraf se salaam. Aap ko mujh se woh baat pesh nahin aayegi jo aap ko buri lage. Main apne Rubb se aap ke liye magfirat aur hidayat maangoonga. Woh mujh par bahut meharban hai.
48: Aur main aap ko aur un buton ko chhod deta hoon jin ki aap Allah ke siwa ibadat karte hain, aur main sirf apne Rubb ko pukaroonga, Us ke saath kisi ko sharik thehraye baghair. Ho sakta hai ke jab main Us se dua karoon to Woh mujhe mehroom na rakhe, warna main Us se dua karne mein na-kaam rahoonga.'
49: Chunanche jab unhon ne unhein aur un maaboodon ko chhod diya jin ki woh Allah ke siwa ibadat karte the, to Maine un ke ghar walon ka khasaara poora kar diya aur unhein un ka beta Ishaq (alaihis salaam) diya aur un ka pota Yaqub (alaihis salaam) diya. Aur in mein se har ek ko Maine nabi banaya.
50: Aur apni rehmat se Maine unhein nabuwwat ke saath bahut si bhalai bhi di. Aur Maine un ke liye aisi achhi taarif qayam ki jo logon ki zubaanon par baaqi hai.
51: Aur aey Rasool, us Quran mein, jo aap par utara gaya, Moosa (alaihis salaam) ka qissa bayan kijiye. Woh chune hue aur pasandeeda the, aur woh rasool aur nabi the.
52: Maine unhein us pahaad ki us simt se pukara jo Moosa (alaihis salaam) ke lihaz se daayein taraf thi, aur Maine unhein baat-cheet ke liye qareeb kiya, jahan Allah ne unhein apna kalaam sunaya.
53: Aur Maine apne fazl aur apni meharbani se unhein un ka bhai Haroon (alaihis salaam) nabi bana kar diya, un ki us dua ke jawab mein jo unhon ne apne Rubb se maangi thi.
54: Aur aey Rasool, us Quran mein, jo aap par utara gaya, Ismail (alaihis salaam) ka qissa bayan kijiye. Woh apne wade ke sachche the: jab bhi koi wada karte to use poora karte, aur woh rasool aur nabi the.
55: Woh apne ghar walon ko namaz qayam karne aur zakaat dene ka hukm dete the, aur un ka Rubb un se khoob raazi tha.
56: Aur aey Rasool, us Quran mein, jo aap par utara gaya, Idris (alaihis salaam) ka qissa bayan kijiye. Woh bade sachche the aur apne Rubb ki nishaniyon par pakka iman rakhte the, aur woh Allah ke nabiyon mein se the.
57: Aur Maine un ka zikr us nabuwwat se buland kiya jo Maine unhein di, aur isi liye woh ek buland darje par the.
58: Jin logon ka zikr is surah mein hua, Zakariya se shuru karke Idris (alaihimus salaam) tak, wahi hain jinhein Allah ne nabuwwat se nawaza: Adam (alaihis salaam) ki aulaad mein se, aur un logon ki aulaad mein se jinhein Maine Nooh (alaihis salaam) ke saath kashti mein uthaya, aur Ibrahim ki aulaad aur Yaqub (alaihimus salaam) ki aulaad mein se, aur un logon mein se jinhein Maine Islam ki hidayat se nawaza aur jinhein Maine chuna aur nabi banaya. Jab woh Allah ki aayatein padhi jaati sunte the to woh Allah ko sajda karte the aur Us ke khauf se rote the.
59: In chune hue nabiyon ke baad aise log un ke janasheen bane jo burai aur gumraahi par the, jinhon ne namaz zaaya kar di aur use us tareeqe se ada nahin kiya jaisa chahiye tha, aur jo apni khwahishon ke peeche chal kar gunah karte rahe, jaise zina. Yeh log Jahannam mein burai aur na-umeedi se do-chaar honge.
60: Magar jinhon ne apni kotahi aur apni hadd se barhne se tauba ki, Allah par iman laaye, aur neik kaam kiye: jin mein yeh sifaat hain woh Jannat mein daakhil honge aur un ke aamaal ka ajr zarra bhar kam nahin kiya jayega.
61: Rehne aur hamesha baaqi rehne ke woh baagh jin ka Rehman ne apne bandon se gaib mein wada kiya ke Woh unhein un mein daakhil karega. Unhon ne unhein dekha nahin magar un par iman laaye. Aur Allah ka Jannat ka wada, chahe woh gaib mein hai, be-shak poora ho kar rahega.
62: Wahan woh na koi be-kaar baat sunenge aur na koi gandi baat. Balke woh ek doosre ko salaam karte sunenge aur farishton ka unhein salaam bhi. Aur unhein har woh khana diya jayega jis ki woh chaahat karenge, subah aur shaam.
63: Yeh Jannat, jis ki yeh sifaat bayan hui, wahi hai jo Main apne un bandon ko doonga jinhon ne Mere ahkaam poore kiye aur Meri mana ki hui cheezon se bache.
64: Aur aey Jibreel (alaihis salaam), Muhammad ﷺ se keh dijiye: farishte apni marzi se nahin utarte. Woh sirf Allah ke hukm se utarte hain. Jo kuch hamare aage hai Aakhirat mein, jo kuch hamare peeche hai duniya mein, aur jo kuch duniya aur Aakhirat ke darmiyan hai, sab Allah hi ka hai. Aur aey Rasool, aap ka Rubb kisi cheez ko nahin bhoolta.
65: Wohi aasmaano ka Khaaliq hai aur zameen ka Khaaliq, aur un ka maalik aur un ko chalane wala. Aur Wohi un ke darmiyan ki har cheez ka Khaaliq, maalik aur chalane wala hai, lihaza sirf Usi ki ibadat kijiye, kyunke Wohi yakta ibadat ka haqdaar hai. Aur Us ki ibadat par jame rahiye, kyunke Us ka na koi misl hai aur na koi sharik jo is ibadat mein Us ka saajhi ho.
66: Aur kafir, jo dobara zinda hone ko jhutlata hai, mazaaq udate hue kehta hai: kya jab main mar jaoonga to main apni qabr se doosri baar zinda nikaloonga? Yeh to door ki baat hai.
67: Kya yeh shaks, jo dobara zinda hone ko jhutlata hai, yaad nahin karta ke Maine use is se pehle paida kiya jab woh kuch bhi nahin tha? Phir woh pehli takhleeq ko doosri takhleeq ki daleel bana sakta hai, jab ke doosri takhleeq us se zyada aasan aur halki hai.
68: Aey Rasool, aap ke Rubb ki qasam, Main unhein un ki qabron se nikaal kar hashr ke maidan tak le aaoonga, un shaytanon ke saath jinhon ne unhein gumraah kiya. Phir Main unhein Jahannam ke darwazon ki taraf dhakel doonga, zaleel aur apne ghutnon ke bal.
69: Phir Main har gumraah giroh mein se un logon ko sakhti se nikaaloonga jo sab se zyada nafarmani karne wale the, aur yeh un ke sardar hain.
70: Phir Main khoob jaanta hoon ke kaun log sab se zyada is ke haqdaar hain ke Aag mein daakhil hon aur us ki garmi sahein aur us ka azaab bhugtein.
71: Aur aey logo, tum mein koi aisa nahin jo us pul se na guzre jo Jahannam par rakha jayega. Aap ke Rubb ne is guzarne ko ek laazimi faisla bana diya hai aur koi Us ke faisle ko rok nahin sakta.
72: Phir is pul se guzarne ke baad Main un logon ko bacha loonga jo apne Rubb se darte rahe, Us ke hukm par chal kar aur Us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bach kar, aur Main zaalimon ko ghutnon ke bal gire hue chhod doonga aur woh us se bhaag na sakenge.
73: Aur jab logon ke saamne Mere Rasool par utari hui khuli aayatein padhi jati hain, to kafir mominon se kehte hain: hamare dono giroh mein se kaun sa rehne aur basne mein behtar aur majlis aur jamaat mein buland hai: hamara giroh ya tumhara giroh?
74: Aur in kafiron se pehle, jo apni maali bartari par fakhr karte hain, Maine kitni hi ummatein halak kar dein jo in se maal mein aur apni zaahiri shaan mein, apne qeemti kapdon aur apne jismon ke aish ki wajah se, aage thin.
75: Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: Rehman un logon ko mohlat deta rahega jo apni gumraahi mein pade hain, taake woh us mein aur gehre utar jayein, yahan tak ke jab woh woh cheez dekh lein jis se unhein daraya gaya tha, ya to duniya mein jald aane wala azaab ya Qayamat ke din tak tala gaya azaab, tab unhein maaloom hoga ke kaun bure haal mein hai aur kis ka lashkar sab se kamzor hai: un ka giroh ya mominon ka giroh.
76: Aur un logon ko mohlat dene ke bar-aks, taake woh gumraahi mein aur gehre utar jayein, Allah un logon ko aur zyada hidayat aur itaat deta hai jo hidayat par hain. Aur neik aamaal, jo hamesha ki khushi tak le jate hain, aey Rasool, aap ke Rubb ke nazdeek apne badle ke lihaz se zyada faide-mand hain aur un ka anjaam bhi behtar hai.
77: Aey Rasool, kya aap ne us aadmi ko dekha jo Meri dalilon ka inkaar karta hai, Meri tambeeh ko rad karta hai aur kehta hai: agar main mar jaoon aur dobara zinda kiya jaoon, to mujhe zaroor bahut sa maal aur bahut si aulaad di jayegi?
78: Kya use gaib ka ilm hai ke us ne yeh kisi daleel ke saath kaha? Ya us ka apne Rubb se koi ahd hai ke Woh use Jannat mein daakhil karega aur use maal aur aulaad dega?
79: Baat waisi nahin jaisa us ne daawa kiya. Main zaroor likh loonga jo woh kehta aur karta hai; aur Main use us ke azaab ke oopar aur azaab doonga, us jhoot ki wajah se jo woh ghadta hai.
80: Aur jo maal aur jo aulaad woh peeche chhodega us ka Main waris banunga jab Main use halak kar doonga, aur woh Qayamat ke din Hamare paas bilkul yakta aayega, us maal aur us shohrat se mehroom jis se woh maza leta tha.
81: Aur mushrikon ne apne liye Allah ke siwa maabood bana liye, taake woh un ke liye sahara aur madad ka zariya hon.
82: Baat waisi nahin jaisa unhon ne daawa kiya. Jin ki woh Allah ke siwa ibadat karte the, woh Qayamat ke din mushrikon ki apni ibadat ka inkaar karenge. Woh un se bezaari karenge aur un ke dushman ban jayenge.
83: Aey Rasool, kya aap ne nahin dekha ke Maine shaytanon ko bheja aur unhein kafiron par musallat kar diya ke woh unhein gunah karne par ubhaarein aur doosron ko Allah ke deen se roken?
84: Aey Rasool, Allah se un ke jald azaab maangne mein jaldi na kijiye. Main un ki umron ka theek hisaab rakh raha hoon, yahan tak ke jab un ki mohlat ki muddat khatam ho jayegi, Main unhein wahi saza doonga jis ke woh haqdaar hain.
85: Aey Rasool, Qayamat ka woh din yaad kijiye jab Main un logon ko jo apne Rubb se darte rahe, Us ke hukm par chal kar aur Us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bach kar, apne Rubb ke paas ek aise wafd ki tarah jama karoonga jis ki izzat aur jis ka adab kiya jata hai.
86: Aur Main kafiron ko pyaase Jahannam ki taraf haankoonga.
87: Yeh kafir ek doosre ke liye sifarish karne ka ikhtiyar nahin rakhenge, siwaye un ke jinhon ne duniya mein Allah se ahd kar rakha tha ke woh Us par aur Us ke rasoolon par iman rakhte hain.
88: Aur Yahood ne, Nasara ne aur kuch mushrikon ne kaha: Rehman ne beta bana liya.
89: Aey woh logo jo yeh kehte ho, tum ek bahut bhayanak baat le aaye.
90: Is na-pasandeeda baat se qareeb hai ke aasman phat padein, zameen shaq ho jaye, aur pahaad reza reza ho kar gir padein.
91: Yeh sab is liye ke unhon ne Rehman ke liye beta thehraya. Allah is se bahut buland hai.
92: Aur Rehman ke liye yeh zaib nahin deta ke Woh koi beta banaye, kyunke Woh is se paak hai.
93: Aasmaano aur zameen mein koi farishta, koi insaan aur koi jinn aisa nahin jo Qayamat ke din apne Rubb ke saamne jhuk kar na aaye.
94: Us ne unhein poori tarah jaan liya hai aur unhein theek theek gin rakha hai. Un ka kuch Us se chhipa nahin.
95: Aur un mein se har ek Qayamat ke din Us ke paas yakta aayega, bina kisi madadgaar ke aur bina kisi maal ke.
96: Jo log Allah par iman laate hain aur aise neik kaam karte hain jin se Allah raazi hota hai, Allah un ke liye mohabbat paida kar dega: khud un se mohabbat karke aur unhein apne bandon ka mehboob bana kar.
97: Aey Rasool, Hum ne yeh Quran aap ki apni zubaan mein utaar kar aasan kar diya, taake aap un logon ko khush-khabri dein jo Mere ahkaam poore karke aur Meri mana ki hui cheezon se bach kar Mujh se darte hain, aur taake aap aisi qaum ko daraayein jo jhagadne mein sakht aur haqq maanne mein hath-dharam hai.
98: Aur aap ki qaum se pehle Maine kitni hi ummatein halak kar deen! Kya aap aaj un ummaton mein se kisi ek ko bhi mehsoos karte hain, ya un ki koi aahat sunte hain? Jo cheez un par aayi woh doosron par bhi aa sakti hai jab Allah ijazat de.
